sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Physical Charter of Prilled Urea and Potassium Chloride

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States (1986, as amended); Title Two economic and investment protections
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus); trade and investment facilitation with Pacific Forum member states
No comprehensive double taxation agreement is currently in force with major trading partner jurisdictions.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Principal statutes: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2018, 22 MIRC Ch.1, as amended; Business Corporations Act 1990, 32 MIRC Ch.1, as amended, including registered agent obligations and beneficial ownership record-keeping provisions; Beneficial Ownership (Non-Resident Companies) Regulations 2021, issued by the Registrar of Corporations; AML/CFT Customer Due Diligence Directive No. 2/2021 of the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of valid passport of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of the beneficial owner's residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing jurisdiction is an HCCH member; otherwise consular legalization by a Republic of the Marshall Islands diplomatic or consular post with jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certificate of incumbency and corporate resolution for each corporate Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or authorized officer of the corporate beneficial owner, constituted before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization depending on the country of incorporation and recognition status of the issuing authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized bank reference and professional reference letter for each Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank and independent legal/accounting professional in the beneficial owner's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as required by the receiving RMI registered agent and the AML/CFT framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory automated screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the RMI domestic designated-persons and sanctions list. FATF high-risk and non-cooperative jurisdictions are automatically escalated. PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, senior-management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Registrar of Corporations – Online Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation System
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in the Latin alphabet using English-language characters. The name must be distinguishable in the corporate register from all names reserved or registered by other entities. A foreign-language name is permitted only if a certified English transliteration is submitted. The corporate designator must be one of: Corporation, Incorporated, Limited, or Company, or an accepted abbreviation such as Corp., Inc., Ltd., or Co.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank (unless licensed under the Banking Act)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An administrative appeal must be lodged with the Registrar of Corporations in writing within 14 calendar days of rejection. The appeal must state the grounds for review and attach the original rejection notice, the proposed names, and the statutory appeal fee. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 15 business days. A further appeal lies to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands within 28 days of the Registrar's final decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are acceptable for a non-resident Business Corporation provided a licensed registered agent maintains a physical address in the Marshall Islands and all corporate records are available at that registered office. There is no statutory requirement to maintain employees, a physical trading presence, or rented premises in the Marshall Islands.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 20% risk-weighted probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months of registration, driven by the medium-risk agrochemical commodities classification; inspections would be conducted by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit or the Registrar of Corporations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name availability search and reservation
Government incorporation filing fee for a Business Corporation (Non-Resident)
Initial registered agent and registered office service (annual)
UBO piercing and AML/CFT customer due diligence compliance package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent or licensed compliance firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening per UBO and officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed AML data provider or registered agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille, and consular legalization of UBO passports, bank references, and corporate resolutions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and relevant competent legalization authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; cost per UBO

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate seal, minute book, and statutory registers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent or corporate services provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal opinion on pre-incorporation eligibility and non-resident tax-exempt status
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent counsel admitted in the Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed-fee specialist opinion based on prevailing market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended, codified at Title 10, Chapter 1 of the Marshall Islands Revised Statutes (10 MIRC §§ 101–180); principal sections: § 101 (formation), § 104 (incorporators), § 106 (articles of incorporation), § 109 (registered office and registered agent), § 110 (certificate of incorporation), § 145 (bylaws), § 146 (organizational meeting).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-01) filed in English
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None; no minimum authorized or paid-up capital is required by the BCA. A nominal capitalization (e.g., 500 shares of no par value) is accepted, and no escrow account or bank deposit is required as a condition of incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers hereby subscribe to five hundred (500) shares of no-par-value common stock as allotted by the Incorporator in the sum of US$500; that the registered office of the corporation in the Republic of the Marshall Islands shall be maintained at the offices of [Registered Agent, Majuro], and the named Registered Agent is appointed to serve; that the proposed Bylaws are adopted in full; that [Name] be appointed President and [Name] Secretary/Treasurer, each to serve until successors are elected; that the officers are authorized to open bank accounts, execute signature cards, endorse documents, and affix the corporate seal; and that the officers shall maintain the minute book, share ledger, and statutory corporate registers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, RMI; filing may be effected through an accredited RMI Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name availability application stating up to three preferred corporate names in English. The Registrar verifies that the proposed name is distinguishable from all registered names and does not imply a governmental or professional designation. If available, the name is reserved for a non-renewable 30-day period. For this fertilizer trading entity, a neutral commercial name without regulated words such as 'bank' or 'trust' is recommended.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Letter of authorization from the proposed entity to the Registered Agent
Identification of the applicant or incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or prohibited wording, the applicant may immediately resubmit with alternative names; an administrative request for reconsideration may be lodged with the Registrar, and any refusal is subject to administrative appeal within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Prepared by a qualified RMI attorney or accredited Registered Agent; notarized before a notary public or RMI Consular Officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in English stating: (i) the corporate name; (ii) the name and Majuro address of the Resident Agent; (iii) the purpose clause (any lawful business, including the wholesale physical charter of agrochemical commodities); (iv) the authorized share structure (e.g., 500 shares of no par value); (v) perpetual duration; and (vi) the incorporator's name and address. The incorporator must execute the Articles, and the signature must be notarized. The Registered Agent named in the Articles must execute a separate written consent.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Registered Agent consent to appointment
Copy of the incorporator's passport or national ID
Anti-money-laundering/KYC information of the beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar or Registered Agent identifies a defect, the Article is returned for corrective amendment; clerical errors may be cured by filing a Certificate of Correction, while substantive changes require resignation or board consent prior to re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Articles of Incorporation and Payment of the State Filing Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Majuro; filings may be lodged physically or electronically via an approved Registered Agent portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit the fully executed Articles of Incorporation, together with the Registered Agent consent and the US$250 government filing fee, by courier or through the Registered Agent's approved electronic filing interface. Pay the fee by wire transfer, bank draft, or agent's consolidated account. Obtain a date-stamped receipt and, if requested, an acknowledgment of filing from the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Incorporation
Registered Agent consent form
Proof of government fee payment (wire confirmation or bank draft)
Registered Agent AML/KYC clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency notice or queries a provision, the filer has 21 days to submit corrected Articles or a supplemental affidavit; failing cure within that window requires a new filing with an additional fee. A formal administrative objection may be made to the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation and Confirmation of Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated as of the filing date, and the corporate existence commences. The Registered Agent issues a formal acceptance confirmation and files any required notice with the Ministry of Finance if the entity will hold an actual physical office in the Republic. The certified Articles and Certificate are delivered to the incorporator.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
Certified copy of the filed Articles of Incorporation
Registered Agent acceptance confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical or jurat errors, apply for re-issuance with a Certificate of Correction; losses or misplaced originals may be replaced by certified copies upon affidavit and payment of a replacement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Adoption of Bylaws, and First Board Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Incorporator, acting by unanimous written consent in lieu of meeting pursuant to 10 MIRC § 146
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold, or waive by unanimous written consent, the organizational meeting. Adopt the corporate Bylaws, approve the share subscription and allotment, elect the initial directors and officers, approve the Registered Office and Agent designation, adopt a bank resolution authorizing the opening of accounts, and approve issuance of share certificates. All resolutions must be recorded in the corporate minute book, and the share ledger and stock transfer register must be created.
required_dossiers: Waiver of notice or organizational meeting consent
First Board Resolutions as adopted
Corporate Bylaws
Share certificate book and share ledger
Officer acceptance forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the written consent lacks required signatures or a procedural formality, a corrective unanimous written consent may be executed nunc pro tunc; any old resolution should be annexed as a corrected exhibit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Non-Resident Tax Exemption Certification and Ancillary Business License Trim
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Finance and RMI Taxation Office, Majuro; Business License Section where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Where the corporation will not derive income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands, apply for a formal Non-Resident Tax Exemption Certificate confirming that no income tax or withholding tax applies to foreign-source income. If the corporation will maintain a physical office or employ staff in Majuro, obtain the standard Business License; if a foreign investor will carry on a licensed activity within RMI, the Foreign Investment Business License Act may additionally apply. For a pure offshore chartering entity with no local presence, no license is statutorily mandated.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and certified Articles
Written confirmation of non-resident status and no local-source income
Registered Agent certificate as to registered office
Business License application form (only if local physical presence is established)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax exemption application is queried, provide a board certificate confirming the absence of RMI-source income; an appeal may be filed with the Minister of Finance within 30 days of any adverse determination.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial licensing authority is engaged for a pure wholesale physical-charter trading entity under ISIC 4669. The Ministry of Resources and Development (Business and Trade Licensing Division) would only be relevant if the entity later establishes a physical warehouse, blending plant, or fertilizer repackaging facility in the Republic.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No manufacturing or industrial operating permit is required for the physical charter and wholesale trading of prilled urea and potassium chloride. An optional general Business License under the Business License Act may be obtained from the Ministry of Finance solely for administrative convenience or if a local office is maintained; no sectoral agrochemical trading license is mandated.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category E (Exempt) — no construction activity, processing plant, fixed emission source, or land disturbance is involved; no EIA Registration and no Full EIA Report obligation applies to the non-presence chartering/trading entity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No local wastewater, volatile organic compound (VOC), or solid-waste discharge thresholds apply to the entity itself. Chartered ocean vessels operating in or transiting RMI waters must comply with MARPOL Annex V (garbage), Annex IV (sewage), and the IMO Ballast Water Management Convention; storage or repackaging of urea/potash at any future RMI facility would trigger EPA waste storage standards and fertilizer runoff controls.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for industrial premises because no physical manufacturing, storage, or repackaging site will be owned or occupied. If a representative administrative office is later opened in Majuro, it must obtain a Fire Safety Clearance from the RMI Fire and Rescue Authority, pass structural occupancy inspection under the National Building Code, and secure an employer registration for any local employees. The registered office maintained by the Registered Agent does not trigger these requirements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance & Administration, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); corporate registration administered by the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General. There is no national VAT/GST administration or e-filing portal; annual corporate fees are settled through the Registrar of Corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident domestic Business Corporation is statutorily exempt from income tax and gross revenue tax under Section 118 of the Business Corporations Act. No TIN or VAT ID is required for purely offshore operations. The entity obtains a corporate registration number by filing articles of incorporation through a licensed resident agent and paying the annual franchise fee; a Certificate of Good Standing serves as the de facto tax identity document. If the entity were to derive income from sources within the Marshall Islands, it would register with the Revenue Division of the Ministry of Finance under the Gross Revenue Tax Act, but such registration is inapplicable to a non-resident BC engaged exclusively in offshore fertilizer wholesale.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available. The Marshall Islands has no check-the-box regime, no hybrid mismatch election, and no elective inclusion mechanism. The exemption from all local taxes under Business Corporations Act Section 118 is mandatory for non-resident domestic corporations, and the entity cannot elect to be treated as tax resident or taxable.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST. The Marshall Islands imposes no value-added tax or sales tax; the only indirect-type levy is the 3% Gross Revenue Tax on locally sourced gross revenue and customs import duties, neither of which applies to a non-resident BC's offshore wholesale of prilled urea and potassium chloride.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. No VAT/GST registration threshold exists. A Gross Revenue Tax registration obligation would arise only if the entity were 'carrying on business' within the Republic of the Marshall Islands and deriving local-source revenue; such activity is not contemplated for the MH_BC non-resident entity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The Republic of the Marshall Islands maintains no electronic invoicing mandate, no real-time fiscal clearance system, no API reporting requirement, and no digital stamping regime for commercial invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The Marshall Islands has no VAT/GST zero-rating mechanism and imposes no export duty on goods. The offshore sale and physical charter of fertilizer from a non-resident BC is entirely outside the scope of Marshall Islands indirect taxation, so no claim for a 0% export VAT rate can arise.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (only if goods are physically cleared through RMI customs; generally not required for offshore transshipment)
Bill of Lading or non-negotiable sea waybill evidencing the international movement of goods
Commercial invoice and packing list with Incoterms and no local consumption in the Marshall Islands
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank MT103/LC settlement record evidencing payment from the overseas buyer
Certificate of Origin (retained as supporting evidence, optional in the absence of VAT)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: As no VAT refund or zero-rating claim mechanism exists in the Marshall Islands, no VAT clawback liability can attach. However, false declarations made to the Registrar of Corporations or to RMI Customs in respect of exempt status, the nature of the transaction, or the non-resident character of the entity may be prosecuted under the Business Corporations Act and the Customs Act, exposing the corporation and its directors to fines, forfeiture of goods, imprisonment, revocation of the Certificate of Incorporation, and retrospective assessment of any unpaid gross revenue tax plus penalties and interest for a period of up to six years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not maintain a domestic central bank or an independent foreign exchange administration. The official lawful currency is the United States dollar (USD). Banking supervision is administered by the Banking Commissioner within the Ministry of Finance; anti-money laundering and counter-financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) supervision is the responsibility of the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMI is a fully dollarized jurisdiction, so there are no exchange controls imposed by local law or regulation. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are freely convertible into USD, and there are no statutory approvals for profit remittance, dividend distributions, or capital repatriation. In practice, financial institutions apply a documentary AML/KYC review to remittances, including source-of-funds evidence and sanctions screening, but no governmental exchange-control hurdle exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender rule exists in the RMI. Export receipts may be retained, used, or repatriated freely in USD or any commercially agreed currency. There is no mandatory statutory timeline, no minimum conversion ratio, and no central bank filing requirement for export proceeds. Banks may, however, require supporting trade documents for underwriting and regulatory compliance.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI payment providers are not licensed deposit-taking institutions in the RMI and may not be used as the primary regulated account for statutory capital or trade settlements. Feasibility is Low for treasury anchored in the RMI, because the RMI Banking Act requires a licence for deposit-taking and the Banking Commissioner does not recognise unlicensed foreign EMIs. Such EMIs may be used only as supplemental payment corridors if the settlement bank is willing to receive from them, but the statutory and compliance treasury accounts must remain at a locally licensed or recognised financial institution.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: RMI law does not explicitly mandate physical attendance by directors for bank onboarding. In practice, Bank of Marshall Islands and Pacific clearing banks require an interview, usually by video conference, coupled with notarised or apostilled identification and corporate documents. For a non-resident Business Corporation involved in medium-risk agrochemical trade, physical presence is not automatically required, but the bank may require the registered agent, directors, and UBOs to provide certified KYC bundles and to complete a live AML/origin-of-funds interview. A physical visit to Majuro may be requested if counterparty jurisdictions or ownership structures are deemed high risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Business Corporation with no physical operations in the RMI and full tax-exempt status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing from the RMI Registrar, registered agent acknowledgement, board resolution explaining the commercial purpose of the RMI entity, economic-substance rationale for the trading transaction, and a clear corporate/financial statement showing the source and intended use of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex beneficial ownership, including corporate shareholders, nominee officers, or trust/foundation holdings.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete ownership-chain chart to all ultimate natural persons; notarised UBO declarations; passport copies and proof of residential address; corporate register extracts for each intermediate entity; trust deed or foundation document summaries; consolidated KYC forms; and an independent legal opinion from RMI-licensed or recognised counsel confirming the legitimacy of the ownership structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk commodity trade typologies for wholesale urea and potash, including trade-based money laundering or dual-use cargo concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Verified transaction file containing signed purchase and sale contracts, pro forma invoices, commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, warehouse receipts, inspection certificates, maritime shipping documents, insurance certificates, and vessel stowage plans; comprehensive counterparty KYC and sanctions screening; and a written explanation of the physical commodity flow and delivery chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Difficulty evidencing the source of a capital escrow deposit or incoming shareholder loan in USD.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or management-prepared financial statements, up-to-date bank reference letters from the sending bank, board resolutions approving capital contribution or loan, signed loan or subscription agreements, source-of-wealth analysis, tax payment receipts, and asset transaction statements evidencing the accumulation of the funds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound shareholder capital is routed via SWIFT MT103 or SWIFT MT202 in USD to the Bank of Marshall Islands USD account. The beneficiary field must clearly reference the entity name and account number, and the payment field should state 'Capital contribution under RMI Business Corporations Act' or equivalent. Since the RMI has no central bank approval requirement, the transaction is cleared through the bank's US correspondent network via Fedwire or CHIPS. The receiving bank will require a board resolution, UBO declaration, source-of-funds evidence, and the underlying subscription or share issuance documentation before crediting the capital escrow account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for fertilizer cargoes are cleared through (i) open-account payments by SWIFT MT103 or Fedwire; (ii) documentary commercial letters of credit issued via SWIFT MT700 and advised/confirmed by global banks under UCP600; (iii) documentary collections (SWIFT MT400) for the presentation of title documents; and (iv) cash-in-advance wire transfers via SWIFT MT103. The RMI has no domestic real-time gross settlement system; therefore, all USD clearing is performed via the correspondent banking network in the United States.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright foreign-exchange forward contracts between USD and trade-settlement currencies such as EUR, CNY, INR, IDR, or VND executed with a licensed international bank under an ISDA master agreement.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies with limited convertibility, including USD/CNY and USD/IDR, cash-settled in USD.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps or simple cross-currency swaps where a long-term fertiliser supply agreement or vessel charter creates recurring non-USD payment exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation; no extension is generally available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of USD 100 plus 10% of the annual fee per month of delinquency; unpaid fee for 12 consecutive months may trigger administrative strike-off or dissolution by the Registrar

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a private non-resident Business Corporation under the RMI Business Corporations Act; no revenue or asset threshold applies. Audit is strictly required only for regulated financial institutions, insurers, trustees, or public issuers.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No local GAAP is prescribed; records may be maintained on IFRS or US GAAP. No audited statutory financial statements need to be filed in the Marshall Islands.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Shareholding transfers do not require public filing. The non-resident Business Corporation must keep an internal stock ledger and beneficial ownership records at its registered agent's office; no annual UBO declaration is filed with the Registrar, but records must be produced to RMI authorities upon lawful demand.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for non-resident Business Corporations on foreign-source income; 12.5% on income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Income Tax Act 1989, Section 10).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-Resident Domestic Corporation exemption: effective rate 0% on non-Marshall Islands-source income. No VAT/GST, payroll, capital gains, or net worth taxes. The sole annual fiscal cost is the BCA franchise tax (USD 200–USD 2,500 depending on authorized share capital). A 3% Gross Revenue Tax (Gross Revenue Tax Act 2014) may apply to foreign-owned businesses operating on-island above statutory revenue thresholds; sectoral exemptions may apply.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: BCA Annual Report and Franchise Tax Return (Form BCA-AR) — filed through the licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent and the RMI Registrar of Corporations. No corporate income tax return is required for a non-resident Business Corporation deriving no Marshall Islands-source income. Resident entities and entities with RMI-source income file Form MIRT-1 with the RMI Ministry of Finance (Tax Division).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the last day of the month in which the anniversary of incorporation falls (e.g., 31 March for a March incorporation anniversary).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 – Entity name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full corporate name and BCA registration number as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation or Certificate of Merger.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact name; ensure it matches the name on the government fee invoice and the Registered Agent's KYC file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Check-box declaration that the corporation is a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation and derives no income from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select only if no on-island trade or business is conducted; selecting 'Resident' exposes the entity to an on-island income tax filing obligation at 12.5%.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 – Registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical street address of the registered office in Majuro, Marshall Islands, being the address of the licensed Registered Agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Registered Agent's Majuro street address; a P.O. Box alone does not satisfy the physical-address requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address, and license number of the appointed Registered Agent in the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident BC must at all times maintain a licensed Registered Agent and a registered office in the RMI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 – Principal office outside the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full address of the principal executive office outside the Marshall Islands (e.g., Singapore or Dubai operating office).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the actual management address; a mailbox address supports the risk of recharacterization as a shell.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, nationality, residential address, and date of appointment for each director and officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident natural persons are permitted; nominee directors must hold a signed declaration and must not exercise discretion over funds.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, classes, and par value (e.g., 50,000 common shares at USD 1.00 par value); the franchise tax is computed on this basis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the share count with the Registered Agent to avoid underpayment of the franchise tax; a schedule from USD 200 to USD 2,500 applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 – Issued shares and beneficial ownership
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of issued shares and the legal/financial beneficial ownership schedule maintained for AML/CFT purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial owners must be identified for the Registered Agent's KYC file even though the public register is not open; bearer shares are prohibited.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration by a director or authorized officer attesting to the accuracy of the report and to continued non-resident status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Signature may be electronic; knowingly filing a false declaration attracts criminal penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late penalty of 10% of the unpaid annual franchise tax plus continuing interest; failure to pay for two consecutive years may result in administrative dissolution by the Registrar without court action. Reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, late fees, and reinstatement charges.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (Form ESR-1) — filed annually through the Registered Agent to the RMI Registrar on the electronic registry portal when the entity is subject to the Economic Substance Regulations 2019.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of each financial period (accounting reference date).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate name, registration number, Registered Agent, and financial period end date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Included automatically for every domestic corporation; the return becomes substantive only if a relevant activity is declared.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of any relevant activity carried on, including distribution and service centre, shipping, financing and leasing, or pure equity holding.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Wholesale trading of fertilizer with in-house logistics may constitute a distribution and service centre activity; charter of vessels may constitute shipping activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of whether the entity is tax resident outside the Republic of the Marshall Islands and, if so, the jurisdiction and tax reference number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An entity tax resident in a jurisdiction outside the RMI is excluded from the RMI substance test; attach a Certificate of Tax Residency where obtainable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of employees in the RMI, physical premises, annual operating expenditure, and core income-generating activities performed in the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no RMI employees or premises exist, the entity fails the substance test if it claims RMI tax residence; carefully align the declaration with the operating reality.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized officer's declaration as to the completeness and accuracy of the substance metrics.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: False declarations expose directors to criminal penalties and personal liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Penalties up to USD 10,000 for the first year of non-compliance and up to USD 20,000 per year for continued non-compliance; the Registrar may also strike the entity off the register or impose information-gathering orders.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividend distributions by a Business Corporation, whether paid to residents or non-residents.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has no comprehensive double tax treaty network in force; only limited arrangements exist (notably with the United States on shipping income) and numerous TIEAs. Because the domestic rate is already 0%, no treaty relief application is necessary for outbound dividends. An entity seeking to substantiate its exempt non-resident status to a foreign payor should rely on its Certificate of Incorporation, annual report status, and, where economically warranted, a tax residence certificate issued by the RMI Ministry of Finance; foreign tax authorities may nevertheless deny residence claims where management and control occur elsewhere.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and debt interest in the RMI; the RMI imposes no interest or royalty withholding tax on payments to non-residents. Inbound payments from counterparty jurisdictions remain subject to that jurisdiction's domestic withholding rules because no DTA reduces those rates.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 0 — the RMI prescribes no statutory transfer pricing documentation, Local File, Master File, or CbCR obligations; legal tender is the US dollar. Where related-party transactions are booked in the RMI entity, the group must nonetheless be prepared to satisfy the documentation thresholds of the counterparty jurisdiction (e.g., Singapore IRAS transfer pricing documentation at SGD 1,000,000 of related-party loans / SGD 15,000,000 cross-border goods-and-services thresholds) and any CbCR thresholds of the ultimate parent.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations 2019 (as amended) apply to all RMI tax-resident entities carrying on 'relevant activities' (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, IP holding, and distribution and service centre). A pure equity-holding entity may use the reduced substance test. An entity tax resident outside the RMI is excluded from the test but must self-declare and substantiate foreign tax residence. For an agrochemical trading business, the principal relevant-activity characterizations are distribution and service centre and, where vessel chartering is carried on, shipping; the entity must demonstrate adequate employees, premises, and expenditure in the RMI (if RMI-resident) or prove tax residence abroad.
